app.title: CYPMode: Mode-Aware CYP450 Inhibition Screening
app.summary: A person brings a set of chemical structure strings in, either by uploading a plain text file with one per line or pasting them into a box, and runs a substructure screen over them. Unparseable entries are counted and skipped, and the rest come back as a table giving, per compound, which named structural motifs matched and a coarse mechanism call, which can be downloaded as CSV. A second panel shows, for a small reference set, the numbers from an independent physics-based structure prediction — a predicted metal-to-nitrogen distance, a yes/no coordination call against a fixed cutoff, and the prediction's own confidence and affinity scores — so the fast screen's calls can be checked against something that was computed a different way. A third panel applies the same screen live to a held-out compound set, joins on whatever rows of the slow structural run have finished so far, reports how many of the set are complete, and exports the merged table.

task.text: Flag which compounds carry a known structural signature, and check those calls against an independent structural prediction for the compounds where one exists.

data.text: Chemical structure strings, one per compound, screened against a fixed set of named substructure patterns; alongside them a per-compound table of numbers read back from an external structure-prediction run (a distance, a binary call, confidence and affinity scores).
data.item: one compound, given as a structure string

stage.text: screening candidate compounds for a mechanism, and confirming the calls against structural prediction

mechanism.text: Three tabbed panels, each ending in a table: an input panel with a file upload, a paste box and a run button that produces a per-compound results table with a CSV download; a read-only table of structural-prediction numbers for the reference set; and a third table that recomputes the screen live over a held-out set, left-joins whatever the long-running structural job has produced, and shows a completion count above it.

field.text: substructure alerts and structure-based validation in medicinal chemistry

workflow.name: screen a set of items for a known structural signature and check the calls against an independent prediction

steps.here: upload a text file with one structure string per line, or paste them into a box; blank and unparseable entries are counted and skipped rather than stopping the run

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: each structure is matched against a fixed set of named substructure patterns, giving the motifs matched and a coarse two-class mechanism call

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: one row per compound with its structure string, the motifs it matched or 'none', and its mechanism call

steps.step: check the computed call against an independent measurement
steps.here: a separate panel reads a checked-in summary of an external structure-prediction run for a small reference set: predicted metal-to-nitrogen distance, a coordination yes/no against a fixed distance cutoff, and the prediction's own confidence and affinity scores

steps.step: track progress toward a target or a total
steps.here: the held-out set is screened live and left-joined with whatever rows the hours-long structural job has finished; a counter shows how many of the set are complete, and unfinished compounds appear with empty result columns
each table has its own CSV download button, named for the table it came from

distinctive: the screen only claims capability, never a confirmed mechanism, so a whole second panel exists to set its calls against an independently computed structural result with a numeric cutoff
the expensive structural step runs outside the interface and can take hours per item, so the joined table deliberately shows partial results with empty columns instead of waiting or erroring
a completion counter over the held-out set tells the person how much of the check has landed so far

the validation panel reads a small checked-in summary file rather than recomputing, so it behaves the same where the heavy model cannot run, and degrades to a warning if that file is missing or malformed
entries that cannot be parsed as structures are counted and reported as skipped, and an empty string is treated as invalid even though the parser accepts it
